newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to help poor pay higher energy rates.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to help poor pay higher energy rates.

text.p: The Hungarian government has approved a plan to help people pay their energy bills following rate hikes that took effect earlier this year, the government spokesman said on Thursday.

Under the plan, which is expected to benefit some 600,000 people living on low or fixed incomes, the government will contribute one billion forints to a private foundation and companies in the energy sector will contribute another 400 million forints, spokesman Elemer Kiss said.

The companies, which include many foreign firms that bought into Hungary's energy sector over the past two years, will provide an additional 250-to-300 million forints for the operation and administration of the foundation, Kiss said.

Energy price hikes amounting to 18.8 percent for natural gas and 24.9 percent for electricity took effect in January, prompting a widespread outcry from people living on pensions or other social security benefits.
